readings: Considering only attendance records whose event exists in the event table, count the attendance records (member-event attendance entries) for each event status. Also give each status's share, as its record count divided by the total record count across all statuses. Show the status, the record count, and the unrounded share.

Considering only attendance records whose event exists in the event table, count the distinct members who attended at least one event of each status. A member who attended events with different statuses is counted once under each status. Give each status's share, as its distinct-member count divided by the sum of the distinct-member counts across all statuses. Show the status, the distinct-member count, and the unrounded share.
queries:
SELECT e.status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a2 JOIN event e2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id) AS share
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
GROUP BY e.status

WITH s AS (
  SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS cnt
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.status
)
SELECT status, cnt AS distinct_member_count, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM s) AS share
FROM s;
